verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a first-party Containers product that runs code "written in any programming language, built for any runtime" as part of Workers apps, and the Sandbox SDK is "Built on Containers." However, no evidence explicitly mentions Docker images or Dockerfiles, or describes a container deploy workflow such as building, pushing, or a wrangler command. Missing for 10: explicit Docker image/Dockerfile packaging support, documented container build/deploy steps, independent or hands-on corroboration of deploying containers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy applications packaged as Docker containers

citations.quote: Run code written in any programming language, built for any runtime, as part of apps built on Workers.
Instead of chaining together API calls or writing Kubernetes operators, you just write TypeScript or JavaScript.
Each sandbox runs in its own isolated container with a full Linux environment
